name: Medicine shortages
value: UK SSPs in force; no widespread rationing
summary: UK Serious Shortage Protocols cover lansoprazole, Estradot and Creon into January; no new protocol issued in November
state: NHSBSA's list checked on 13 Nov shows active Serious Shortage Protocols for lansoprazole orodispersible tablets from 9 Sep to 15 Jan 2027, and for Estradot patches and Creon 25000 capsules to 8 Jan 2027, with no protocol issued or amended since 2 Oct (NHSBSA). In the US, flood damage to an oncology plant in India may prolong shortages of cytarabine, irinotecan and bleomycin (CancerNetwork, 2 Nov). No widespread rationing or cancelled treatment across major health systems has been reported, so the level stays Watch.
for_you: Pharmacists can supply alternatives under a Serious Shortage Protocol without a new prescription. Patients affected can speak to their pharmacist or GP; NHS guidance explains how protocols work.
rubric_hit: Watch: UK Serious Shortage Protocols in force for widely used medicines (Creon, Estradot, lansoprazole), per NHSBSA
basis_detail: FDA, EMA and NHSBSA shortage lists
basis_by: FDA, EMA and NHSBSA shortage lists

sources.title: CancerNetwork — Flood-damaged plant may prolong US chemotherapy shortages to 2028

why: Shipping disruption, factory failures and export curbs can leave essential medicines short, as with US IV fluids after Hurricane Helene in 2024.
drivers: Manufacturing concentrated in India and China, shipping, raw materials, demand spikes, regulation.

rubric.alert: Shortages forcing widespread rationing or cancelled treatment across major health systems.
rubric.watch: A shortage of an essential medicine or supply across several countries, or a UK Serious Shortage Protocol for a widely used medicine.
rubric.normal: No widespread shortages of essential medicines in major health systems.
